x03.title: First-screen bundle reduced from 1.8MB to 620KB
x03.summary: Route-level code splitting combined with on-demand import of echarts reduced the first-screen bundle to 620KB. moment's locale is still bundled in full.
x03.outcome: vite build produced 620.14 kB; moment locale optimization was not done.
x03.learned: Chart libraries and locale are two typical major contributors to frontend bundle size; the gains from on-demand import far outweigh compression config tuning.

x04.title: List changed to virtual scrolling, 10,000 rows at 58fps
x04.summary: Used react-window to render only the visible rows, scroll frame rate for 10,000 rows improved from 22fps to 58fps, replaced fixed row height with estimation plus dynamic measurement.
x04.learned: The performance bottleneck of long lists is the number of DOM nodes rather than the amount of data; virtual scrolling is the only method with an order-of-magnitude benefit.

x02.title: Add 401 silent refresh and request replay to axios interceptor
x02.summary: On 401, first use the refresh token to exchange for a new access token, then replay the original request; a singleton Promise suppresses concurrent refreshes, and only jump to the login page if the refresh fails.
x02.learned: Silent refresh must dedupe concurrent requests, otherwise a batch of requests will trigger multiple refreshes that invalidate each other.

x01.title: Unescaped regex in search box causes blank screen
x01.summary: SearchBar concatenated user input directly into the highlight regex; unclosed parentheses threw a SyntaxError that crashed the list. Changed to escape regex metacharacters first and added an ErrorBoundary.
x01.outcome: vitest 42 pass 0 fail, special characters no longer cause a blank screen.
x01.learned: User input must have metacharacters escaped before entering a regex, the same class of problem as parameterizing before entering SQL.
